title: Project command text uses the same shell contract on every OS
when: A QA Command case or merge verification executes registered project command text on native Windows or POSIX.
need: Write project commands in sh syntax. POSIX runs /bin/sh; native Windows explicitly locates sh.exe in Git for Windows. Missing Git sh refuses with project_command_shell_unavailable and asks for Git for Windows installation and its cmd directory on PATH.
surface: QA CLI guidance and the captured command refusal.
review: Source tests exercise Git installation layouts, quoted text, exit status and named missing-shell recovery; Windows and macOS suite runs own platform proof.
